verdict.rationale: Spline's own Version History lets designers access and preview all saved versions, manually save new versions, and recover previous file states, and the pricing page lists file version history as a feature. The docs do not say manual saves can be named as milestones, and previewing a version is not the same as comparing versions. Missing for 10: naming of saved versions/milestones, side-by-side or diff comparison between versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, full version history lets me name milestones, compare, and restore any earlier state of a file

citations.quote: This feature helps you track changes, recover previous file states, and manually save new versions as needed.
Version History allows you to access and preview all the saved versions of your files.
